method: DRAFT, owner must review. Each gully named in the source was checked as a 60-degree wedge of its flank from the summit, out to its reported lava flow length, using PROVISIONAL thresholds. It counts as detected only if flagged area is above every quiet track 111 pair in the same wedge.
